title: 21784, A NOVEL HUMAN CALCIUM CHANNEL FAMILY MEMBER AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The invention provides isolated nucleic acids molecules, designated 21784 nucleic acid molecules, which encode novel calcium channel members. The invention also provides antisense nucleic acid molecules, recombinant expression vectors containing 21784 nucleic acid molecules, host cells into which the expression vectors have been introduced, and nonhuman transgenic animals in which a 21784 gene has been introduced or disrupted. The invention still further provides isolated 21784 proteins, fusion proteins, antigenic peptides and anti-21784 antibodies. Diagnostic methods utilizing compositions of the invention are also provided.
